input: Describe the image, specifying the region, climate, and landscape features.
output: This satellite image, captured during the summer season in Serbia, showcases a predominantly forested landscape within the "temperate, no dry season, hot summer" climate zone. The dominant feature is the expansive broad-leaved forest, covering approximately 1,247,000 square meters. Adjacent to the broad-leaved forest are smaller areas of arable land, spanning around 159,000 square meters, which is distributed over two individual areas, one of which is marginal. A marginal area of transitional woodland and shrub, covering less than 5% or 72,000 square meters of the total area, is also present. The broad-leaved forest borders both the arable land and the transitional woodland and shrub.
climate_zone: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer
